title: Tim Taylor's sun-gazing protocols in American Cosmic

tellings.quote: Tim Taylor talks about in Diana's book, American Cosmic, that he's his protocols are around, you know, you know, being in the sunlight, looking at the sun.

plain: A man named Tim Taylor, said to attract UFOs, follows personal routines built around being in sunlight and looking at the sun. Michels says Taylor describes these "protocols" in American Cosmic, a book by the writer Diana Pasulka about people involved with UFOs.
